technical_requirements: Peak concurrency ~3k sessions/region; median request length 200 tokens, 95th ~900 tokens. Target p95 generation latency <350ms for chat and <250ms for short re-rank calls. KV/prefix caching required to hit cost targets. Need region-aware routing and fallback to smaller model (quantized) with automatic downgrade on capacity pressure.
cost_model_summary: We modeled three commit tiers: small (4 H100-eq), medium (8 H100-eq), large (16 H100-eq). Assumptions: baseline throughput per H100-eq = 150 tokens/sec for 32-token bursts and ~40 tokens/sec for 512-token sequences; operational utilization assumptions 50%, 70%, 85% respectively. KV cache hit-rate assumed 45% for personalization workload. Unit economics per 1k tokens (generation + context): small-tier @50% util => $0.035 / 1k tokens; medium-tier @70% util => $0.021 / 1k tokens; large-tier @85% util => $0.015 / 1k tokens. Overage pricing set at 1.8x committed rate. SLA tradeoffs: guaranteed throughput headroom of 15% included in base commit; additional reserved burst pools available at premium. Sensitivity: every +10% cache hit increases effective per-token cost reduction by ~8-10%. We recommended starting at medium (8 GPUs) with autoscale burst to 12 for predictable latency and room to prove higher utilization during POC. Contract ask: 12-month commit with quarterly utilization re-forecast and 10% capacity recontract option.
